# cloptima_llm_gateway_tool_server (Resource)

A registered MCP tool server, referenced by name from cloptima_llm_gateway_policy allowed_tool_servers/denied_tool_servers. Activating a tool server may require approval; until approved, effective_status remains "disabled" and pending_approval_id is set. Eligible administrators can use apply_immediately to approve and activate it in the same apply.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Tool server name, referenced from policy allow/deny lists.

### Optional

- `allowed_tool_names` (List of String) Allowed tool names on this server.
- `apply_immediately` (Boolean) When true and the applying identity has the required role, requesting status = "active" is approved and activated in the same apply. Otherwise, the request follows the standard approval flow. Defaults to false when omitted.
- `denied_tool_names` (List of String) Denied tool names on this server; deny wins over allow.
- `server_type` (String) Tool server type.
- `server_url` (String) Tool server URL.
- `status` (String) Requested status: active or disabled. See effective_status for the current approved status, which may differ while activation approval is pending.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `customer_id` (String) Owning customer ID.
- `effective_status` (String) Current effective status. May be "disabled" while activation approval is pending; see pending_approval_id.
- `id` (String) Tool server ID.
- `pending_approval_id` (String) Set when this server's requested status is queued behind an approval.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
